greymouth-4.name: Brunner Mine Historic Area
greymouth-4.bio: Coal-mine remains reached across a suspension bridge, site of an 1896 explosion that killed 65 workers.
notes: Bio drops 'coke ovens' (not confirmed); DOC gives no hours or visit time, so 24 hours and 1-2 h are judgement for an open-access site.

greymouth-5.name: West Coast Wilderness Trail
greymouth-5.bio: A 133 km cycle trail from Greymouth to Ross through old gold-rush country, ridden in about four days or in day sections.
notes: Operator's 133 km used (Wikipedia 139, council 132). $10 per rider per day is a suggested donation, so free. 3-8 h is a day-section estimate. Use the .co.nz domain.

greymouth-6.name: Croesus Track
greymouth-6.bio: A 22 km miners' track over the Paparoa Range from Blackball to Barrytown, walked in one or two days.
notes: HELD for photo. Coordinates are the Smoke-ho car park (OSM); the placement's mid-range point is wrong. Walking is free; hut booking is extra. 8-16 h is walking time over 1-2 days.

westport-4.name: Carters Beach
westport-4.bio: A sand beach at the edge of Westport on the Kawatiri Coastal Trail, for walking and cycling.
notes: HELD for photo. Bio drops swimming and surfing (unsourced). No official steward; no ticketUrl. Wikipedia puts it 6 km west of Westport. Hours and visit time are judgement.

westland-tai-poutini-7.name: Gillespies Beach
westland-tai-poutini-7.bio: A black-sand beach at the end of a gravel road, with gold-mining relics, short walks and views of the Southern Alps.
notes: Bio trimmed to DOC/Wikipedia wording: dropped quartz pebbles, Aoraki/Mount Cook and Tasman views, seal colony (only a campsite blurb). Coordinates are the DOC campsite at the road end. Road is part narrow and unsealed. Hours and visit time are judgement.

westland-tai-poutini-8.name: Roberts Point Track
westland-tai-poutini-8.bio: A 12.3 km return tramp with swing bridges to a viewpoint over Franz Josef Glacier, 5 h 20 min return.
notes: Not free: cost is the DOC all-day car park charge ($20 per vehicle, $2.50 per half hour). Walking itself is free. Coordinates moved to the Franz Josef Glacier car park (old point was on the riverbed). DOC advises fine weather only.

westland-tai-poutini-9.name: Copland Track
westland-tai-poutini-9.bio: An 18 km, 7 hour tramp up the Copland valley to Welcome Flat Hut and its natural hot pools.
notes: Corrected from '6 to 8 hour'. Coordinates are the Copland Track car park, not Welcome Flat. Walking is free; Welcome Flat Hut is $30 a night extra (31 bunks, booking required). 12-16 h is out and back. Track can close at short notice in heavy rain.

westland-tai-poutini-10.name: Tatare Tunnels Walk
westland-tai-poutini-10.bio: An 80-minute return walk from the end of Cowan Street to old gold-mining water tunnels; bring a torch.
notes: HELD for photo. No Wikipedia article, so wiki unset. DOC gives no hours; 24 hours is judgement. Water may be ankle deep.

westland-tai-poutini-11.name: Whataroa White Heron Colony
westland-tai-poutini-11.bio: The only known New Zealand breeding site of the white heron (kōtuku), visited on a 2.5-hour guided tour from Whataroa.
westland-tai-poutini-11.hours: Tours 9:00 AM, 12:00 PM, 3:00 PM (nesting season, mid Sep - early Mar)
notes: HELD for photo. Operator's season wording used (placement said late Oct to end Feb). Adult $150 (youth $100, child $75), includes DOC permit. Pin is the tour office, 64 Main Road. Not stated whether tours run outside nesting season. wiki is the reserve article (closest); a hand-picked photo is likely better.

kahurangi-4.name: Oparara Arch
kahurangi-4.bio: A limestone arch about 219 m long, reached by a 1.1 km forest walk from the Oparara car park.
notes: No Wikipedia article for the arch, so wiki unset (the 'Oparara Basin Arches' article is shared with Moria Gate and the Basin spot): needs its own photo override. 35 million years is the limestone's age, so dropped. Length 219 m per DOC. Gravel access road is not suitable for campervans. Near-duplicate of kahurangi-2 (owner decision, see existing_fixes).

kahurangi-5.name: Moria Gate Arch and Mirror Tarn Loop
kahurangi-5.bio: A 4 km loop through old-growth forest from the Oparara car park to Moria Gate Arch and Mirror Tarn, 1 h 30.
notes: No Wikipedia article for Moria Gate, so wiki unset; needs its own photo override. Coordinates moved to the Main Oparara Car Park (the old point duplicated kahurangi-4). DOC spells it 'Moira'; 'Moria' is right.

kahurangi-6.name: Scotts Beach
kahurangi-6.bio: A beach on the Heaphy Track coast, a two-hour return walk from Kohaihai.
notes: Corrected from one hour to DOC's 2 h (7 km) return. Pin is the DOC picnic area.

old-ghost-road.name: Old Ghost Road
old-ghost-road.bio: An 85 km track from Lyell to the Mokihinui River, 4 to 5 days on foot or 2 to 3 days by mountain bike.
notes: Cost: $15 day-user contribution to $160 communal hut bunk for through-users (up to 4 nights). 4-8 h is a day-user section; through trip is 2-5 days. Pin is the Lyell trailhead car park.

lake-brunner.name: Lake Brunner
lake-brunner.bio: The largest lake in the north-west South Island, with walks of 20 minutes to 8 hours and a daily TranzAlpine stop at Moana.
notes: Pin is Moana township, where the train stops. Visit time is judgement.

charming-creek-walkway.name: Charming Creek Walkway
charming-creek-walkway.bio: A former mine railway walk of 5.5 km one way to Mangatini Falls, through the Mangatini Tunnel and past old mill sites.
notes: Pin is the Charming Creek Road end car park (north walkway start). The walkway is split in two by a slip. Check wiki 'Charming Creek Tramway' lead photo (its pin is the south end) or hand-pick. 4 h return is judgement.

monro-beach.name: Monro Beach
monro-beach.bio: A beach reached by a 4.7 km, 1 h 20 min track, where Fiordland crested penguins (tawaki) nest from September to November.
notes: 'Sea stacks' dropped (not in DOC). No Wikipedia article; needs a photo override. DOC does not say whether 4.7 km is one way. Track car park is 1.4 km south at -43.70905,169.26474 if the owner prefers the trailhead.

ship-creek.name: Ship Creek Walks
ship-creek.bio: Two short walks from one car park, a kahikatea swamp forest and a dune lake, 20 km north of Haast.
notes: Bio drops 'beach lookout' (not in the DOC text). Pin is the DOC car park.

reefton-1.name: Waiuta
reefton-1.bio: A gold-mining ghost town with the Prohibition Mine, a ball mill and a 2 km town walk, 37 km from Reefton.
notes: Spot of the PROPOSED Reefton destination (waits on owner approval); if declined, add as standalone with the four standalone fields. Distance corrected to 37 km (DOC). Snowy Battery Track is closed for contamination and is not mentioned. Pin is the town-walk car park.

westland-tai-poutini-1.notes: Not free: DOC car park $2.50 per half hour or $20 a day. Pin moved to the Franz Josef Glacier car park (old point 1.3 km east). ticketUrl moved from the park page to DOC's glacier page (title names the glacier); please confirm in a browser. Valley walk is 1.7 km, 30 min, shorter than the stored 1.5-4 h visit time: left to owner.

westland-tai-poutini-2.notes: The park-page link does not name the glacier; DOC has no Fox Glacier page, so the South Side Walk page (6.4 km return, 2 h) is used. Free kept but no car park fee confirmed.

westland-tai-poutini-4.notes: OWNER FLAG: West Coast tourism lists it as temporarily closed (undated) and Freewalks.nz (2024) says closed; operator domain glacierhotpools.co.nz does not resolve, so ticketUrl removed. Old hours 1-9 PM and $32 price are unverified (third-party $29, Wikivoyage 'from $28'). Decide whether to keep the spot, and restore hours and price if it has reopened. Cost left for owner, since a spot needs a cost or free.

westland-tai-poutini-5.bio: A kiwi hatchery for rowi and Haast tokoeka, also home to little blue penguins and tuatara.
westland-tai-poutini-5.notes: $69 adult 48-hour pass (child $45); prices change from 1 Oct 2027.

paparoa-3.notes: River article; check its lead photo shows the gorge, else hand-pick an override.

greymouth-2.bio: A Greymouth brewery with a free museum and a daily 4 pm tour with tastings; the beer is now brewed offsite.
greymouth-2.notes: Tour price $30 is unverified (neither the venue nor the booking page shows one).

westport-3.name: Pounamu Pathway Kawatiri Experience Centre
westport-3.bio: Westport's museum and experience centre, the Museum of Kawatiri, formerly the Coaltown Museum.
westport-3.notes: Renamed; Wikipedia article is still 'Coaltown Museum'. Adult $25 (child $5). Hours are from a directory, not the operator. Old bio's replica Denniston wagon is unsourced and was dropped; the old ticketUrl redirected to a general tourism page.

paparoa.description: Paparoa National Park is best known for the Pancake Rocks at Punakaiki, layered limestone formations that look like giant stacks of pancakes. At high tide with a south-westerly swell, the sea surges through the blowholes and throws up tall walls of spray. Behind the coast lie limestone canyons, caves and the Paparoa Track Great Walk.
paparoa.notes: Destination copy fix: removes 'spectacular' (voice) and matches DOC's swell wording. Applies to destinations.ts, not spots.ts.

notes: Reefton is a proposed new destination (owner approval; needs description, three reasons with photos, tips, best months, header); only its spot Waiuta (reefton-1) is drafted here. Wikivoyage lists Black's Point Museum, Reefton Distilling Co. and the School of Mines for its spots.
Owner decisions carried from placement: Karamea (kahurangi-3) keep or remove; Oparara Basin (kahurangi-2) vs the new Oparara Arch and Moria Gate spots are near-duplicates.
Owner flag: Glacier Hot Pools appears temporarily closed and has no working official site; see existing_fixes.
Unverified: all hours of open-access sites are judgement; Monteith's $30 tour price; Welcome Flat hut fee is extra; Waiuta, Tatare, Carters Beach visit times.
Costs: every spot has free:true or an NZD price except Glacier Hot Pools (cost cleared pending owner).
